evidence.title: Competitor Phase 3 programme in obesity: gzr18
evidence.text: Competitor program in obesity: gzr18 has 5 registered Phase 3 trial(s) in obesity that are active or planned. Lead sponsor(s): Gan & Lee Pharmaceuticals.. Planned enrollment across these trials: 1830 participants. Statuses: ACTIVE_NOT_RECRUITING 1, NOT_YET_RECRUITING 2, RECRUITING 2. Earliest planned primary completion 2026-05, latest 2028-09-28. Trials: NCT06728124, NCT07150975, NCT07292441, NCT07493057, NCT07501832. This is a registry snapshot of trial activity. A registered trial is not evidence that the drug works.

evidence.title: Competitor Phase 3 programme in obesity: berobenatide
evidence.text: Competitor program in obesity: berobenatide has 5 registered Phase 3 trial(s) in obesity that are active or planned. Lead sponsor(s): Pfizer. Planned enrollment across these trials: 1595 participants. Statuses: NOT_YET_RECRUITING 4, RECRUITING 1. Earliest planned primary completion 2028-02-16, latest 2029-03-14. Trials: NCT07792954, NCT07794761, NCT07794774, NCT07823608, NCT07845500. This is a registry snapshot of trial activity. A registered trial is not evidence that the drug works.
